Resolves #19470

Package checks now enforce the operator's source-only release policy even from a built checkout. The npm ignore header excludes all generated `dist/` output, the guard rejects that tree, and generated-file presence is verified after consumer generation. The consumer check installs the source package, supplies its declared build toolchain at the workspace root, generates browser dependencies inside the installed package, checks all 13 runtime-addressed artifacts as regular files, then runs the existing compilation/context checks.

Evidence: L2 local real-pack and fixture checks; CI owns the complete installed-consumer build. No installed Fleet acceptance is required by this leaf.

Change class: restoration. `agent-preflight` is not hosted in Engine; repository pre-commit checks and shared CI baseline apply. Decision Record impact: none; follows the [recorded operator ruling](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18823#issuecomment-6016025585).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | A real-pack regression plants generated parser/editor/highlight/future files alongside source and private-state controls. The local built checkout also passes `npm run check-package-contents`. |
| AC-2 | `checkPackageContents.spec.mjs` rejects generated paths while retaining private-state and ontology carve-out controls. |
| AC-3 | Both workflows pack without a producer-side bundle step. |
| AC-4 | `Consumer Runtime Build` runs the installed copy's `bundle-browser-deps`, verifies all 13 runtime-addressed artifacts, then executes the existing Data, Canvas, App and Main checks; current-head CI is the gate. |
| AC-5 | Package-presence checks move to the installed-generation guard; producer and loader comments reflect consumer generation. Publisher, versions and scaffold publication are unchanged. |

## Deltas from ticket

The consumer's declared toolchain stays hoisted at its workspace root. A nested install could hide the dependency-resolution failures this guard exists to detect. The actual tarball is checked through the existing forbidden-entry predicate before installation. The HighlightJs unit isolates the consumer-generated filename contract; the ESM workspace fixture runs the extracted Engine's real producers before its unchanged build/boot assertions.

## Test Evidence

- Before repair, the real fixture pack shipped five planted generated files, and the prefix predicate accepted generated paths. Both controls pass after repair.
- Actual built checkout: 1,260 local `dist/` files; dry-run package audit passed with 5,991 files, 22.22 MiB tarball / 43.52 MiB unpacked, and no forbidden entries.
- Full consumer execution is left to CI because its existing highlight builder clones upstream, which the local resident Guard Card prohibits. No local substitute bundles were injected.

## Commits

- `04a6176870` — align package policy and the real consumer guard.
- `3078e2b7a8` — adapt the remaining packed fixtures to consumer generation.

- `ea5c071315` — restore generated-file presence coverage in the consumer guard and correct producer/loader docs.

## Post-Merge Validation

None for this leaf. Release publication and create-app's version/publication work retain their existing owners and sequence.

Related: #18823, neomjs/create-app#34.
